description: seastate_nhflow_vortex_si_remote on a multi-block grid (G 50 1, DIVEMesh R 20 1): two blocks of 20 x 40 cells, the same nodes as the one block of _curv. Block 1 is a level-0 patch of nhflow_amr with a seastate_nhflow of its own (seastate_nhflow::attach): the wave force on both blocks, the environment of the waves from both. Against _curv (no same_as: level 0 is block 0 only): the gauges within 3e-6 m with waves, 3e-9 m without (the order of the sums per wave cell). Before: REEF3D refused A 750 on curvilinear and multi-block grids.
covers: the wave force in the SI predictor of a block
